en: Text edit animations now follow nested paragraphs and multi-paragraph changes in Document and Slides.
Review Agent edits in History and choose the browser Agent harness independently of model and reasoning settings.
Linux keeps receiving external Agent edits after atomic saves and Undo.
zh-CN: 嵌套正文与多段修改支持文字编辑动画，Document 与 Slides 自动定位修改页面。
恢复 Agent 修改的 History 审阅入口，并让浏览器 Agent harness 独立于模型和推理设置。
修复 Linux 原子保存与撤销后无法同步外部 Agent 编辑的问题。
